headline: Durable decision memory, deterministic Sim-Watch evidence, and a bounded player-controlled Co-GM context contract shipped with the full rendered-pixel loop.

items.title: Deterministic Sim-Watch evidence
items.evidence: A bounded production-runtime resolver finds real play-by-play and high-impact receipts or emits diagnostics; responsive evidence passed 140/140.

items.title: Permanent Decision Archive
items.evidence: History now projects the cross-season Decision Anthology without introducing a second ledger or causal claims.

items.title: Player-controlled Co-GM packet
items.evidence: Overview exports a fixed-allowlist local packet with command, pressure, thesis, and at most three receipts; no hidden save state or automatic transmission.

items.title: Side-effect-free Studio CLI contracts
items.evidence: Four scripts expose smoke-tested --help entry points through the repository safe-spawn seam.

items.title: Rendered-pixel evidence lens
items.evidence: 32 retained captures across both themes and viewport classes were inspected; component framing now handles only unrelated overlapping chrome.

followUps.evidence: The S74 audit and innovation queues are exhausted at zero open; re-measure before selecting the next work.
followUps.title: Fresh live-code audit

blockers.title: Reply-capable on-domain email
blockers.evidence: football@playfranchisearchitect.com delivery and reply-as identity remain unproved.

blockers.title: Lifecycle authority
blockers.evidence: Registry SPARKED and local FORGE remain unreconciled; Doctor keeps the warning visible.

honestyLedger.title: Aggregate gate corrected
honestyLedger.evidence: The first aggregate exposed an unsafe raw child-process import and a missing machine-readable second-order ledger; both were fixed before the 890/890 replay.

honestyLedger.title: Pixels over geometry
honestyLedger.evidence: Green component geometry still rendered beneath mobile chrome; visual inspection found it and the evidence harness was narrowed and recaptured.

honestyLedger.title: Deployment is not launch
honestyLedger.evidence: The founder authorized this deploy, but green production cannot prove email delivery or reconcile lifecycle authority.
Attempt 1 timed out once in an existing podium journey; a failed-job-only rerun passed 40/40, so no unjustified source patch was made.
honestyLedger.title: CI timeout classified by replay

diffStat.suite: Node 890/890; Playwright 40/40 local + CI rerun; responsive 140/140; visual QA 32; Pages build/smoke; staging 11/11; production 8/8 + 9/9 routes; all GitHub workflows green
